candidate.O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file write outside sandbox (CWE-22, CWE-73)

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the execution API maps a module exception to a clean ok:false, which the instruction names as the refusal form; an unwrapped crash that writes first fails the same outside-unchanged assertion, so no separate patch is meaningful
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: no roles, peers or directions; every tested sink has one caller and one write or removal direction
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the advisory and instruction cover writes and removals only; a reads-only change leaves every security test failing, which sf-image-only.patch already demonstrates
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or token parsing is in scope; locations are plain strings
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority object or secret; the sandbox is operator configuration and an unset sandbox defaults to the server working directory, as stated
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the reference fix changes module-local guards only; the alternative shared-helper design (pass-alt.patch) keeps every stated behaviour and passes the functional group
